title: Reverse in place
description:
Reverse an array with two pointers that walk towards each other.

```
before: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
after:  7 6 5 4 3 2 1
```
hints: `std::end(a)` is the same as `a + 7` without counting by hand.
requirements: `void reverse(int* first, int* last)` where `last` points one past the end.
Only pointer arithmetic and `*`; no indexes.
Works for empty and one-element ranges.
stretch: Rotate the array by k places with three reversals.
